age-calculator.whatIs: A tool that determines an exact age or the time elapsed between any two specific dates.
howToUse: Select a starting date (like a date of birth).
Select an ending date (defaults to today).
View the exact difference in years, months, and days.
age-calculator.howItWorks: It calculates the calendar difference between two dates, accounting for leap years and varying days in months.
age-calculator.workedExample: Inputting Jan 1, 1990 to Jan 1, 2024 returns exactly 34 years, 0 months, and 0 days.
age-calculator.resultInterpretation: The result shows the chronological age or elapsed time.
tipsAndLimitations: Does not account for time zones unless specified.

faq.question: Does it account for leap years?
faq.answer: Yes, it fully accounts for leap years in its calculations.

faq.question: Can I calculate future ages?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set the end date to the future to see how old someone will be.

percentage-calculator.whatIs: A versatile mathematical tool to solve various percentage-related problems instantly.
howToUse: Select the type of percentage problem.
Get the calculated percentage or value immediately.
percentage-calculator.howItWorks: Uses standard percentage formulas like (Part/Whole)*100 to compute the missing variable.
percentage-calculator.resultInterpretation: The result is an exact mathematical percentage or value.
tipsAndLimitations: Ensure you input numbers in the correct fields.
Extremely large numbers might lose some precision.

faq.question: Can it calculate percentage decrease?
faq.answer: Yes, it can calculate both increases and decreases.

json-formatter.whatIs: A developer tool that parses, validates, and beautifies JSON data to make it readable.
howToUse: Paste your minified or raw JSON string into the editor.
json-formatter.howItWorks: It parses the raw string into a JavaScript object and stringifies it with proper indentation.
json-formatter.workedExample: Converts `{"a":1}` into a multi-line string with spaces or tabs.
json-formatter.resultInterpretation: The output is structurally identical but visually formatted.
tipsAndLimitations: Invalid JSON will cause a syntax error.
Comments are not supported in standard JSON.

faq.question: Is my data sent to a server?
faq.answer: No, all formatting happens securely in your local browser.

date-difference-calculator.whatIs: A tool to calculate the exact duration between two calendar dates.
howToUse: View the difference in days, weeks, months, and years.
date-difference-calculator.howItWorks: Subtracts the start date from the end date using calendar algorithms.
date-difference-calculator.resultInterpretation: The time elapsed between the two points.
tipsAndLimitations: End date is generally not included in the count.

faq.question: Does it include the end date?
faq.answer: By default it calculates the duration between, not inclusive of both bounds.

days-between-dates.whatIs: A specific calculator to find the total number of days separating two dates.
days-between-dates.howItWorks: Converts both dates to timestamps and divides the difference by 86,400,000 milliseconds.
days-between-dates.workedExample: March 1 to March 31 is exactly 30 days.
days-between-dates.resultInterpretation: A single integer representing the day count.
tipsAndLimitations: Only outputs days, not months or years.

faq.question: Can I input a past and future date?
faq.answer: Yes, any two valid dates will work.
